detail.longDescription: MIT researchers report GPT-6 Astra raised Qwen3.5’s MATH-500 score from 7.9% to 48.1% by editing just 0.016% of its weights. Huge gain, but not yet proof of general AI engineering. # AI # MachineLearning https:// spaisee.com/article/ai-models- are-starting-to-engineer-other-ai-models?utm_source=mastodon&utm_medium=social # ArtificialIntelligence
